name: import-duty-tariff-calculator
description: US import duty rates from the keyless USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule API: HS code or keyword lookup with duty rates resolved down to the 10-digit statistical line, free trade agreement eligibility by origin country, a shipment duty estimate, Chapter 99 Section 301 and IEEPA lookups, and UN Comtrade bilateral trade flows. No browser, no login, no API key.
